purpose: Bounded CPU comparison after correctness and source commit
first_iteration: retained separately, first invocation for this condition, not cold process or cold hardware
inputs: deterministic formula in tools/benchmark.cpp, no external data
timing: steady_clock around completed synchronous native call including validation, allocation and output disposal
order: fixed declared order, no claim of bias-free benchmarking
contention: one agent measurement workload; ordinary user applications are preserved and external contention may remain
claims: retain every sample and unfavorable case; no general hardware or application speedup claim
